primary_metric: All eligible races; 100 yen per selected ticket; actual official payout / actual investment.

candidate_definitions.saved_top12: Original frozen probability-ranked top twelve, unchanged.
candidate_definitions.top10: Keep the first ten of the original frozen twelve.
candidate_definitions.retain90_min6: Smallest probability-ranked prefix retaining at least 90% of original top-twelve model mass, minimum six and maximum twelve tickets.
candidate_definitions.pair_cap3_top12: Greedily take the highest full-q tickets with at most three tickets for each ordered first-second pair, until twelve tickets.
candidate_definitions.third_temper_half_top12: Preserve each ordered first-second pair mass; replace its conditional third-place distribution by normalized square roots; select the twelve largest resulting scores.
candidate_definitions.two_triple_boxes12: Rank unordered three-rider groups by sum of all six ordered full-q probabilities, then buy all six permutations of the two leading groups.

withdrawal_exclusion.082720261019: Keiokaku 8R; car 3 withdrawn; original refund settlement pending; excluded for every candidate

limitations: Ten days of existing saved predictions; results were already viewed before this continued exploration.
Reconstructed full q covers one day only; source input was saved preclose and the original twelve tickets/probabilities match exactly, but the full vector itself was reconstructed after the races.
No odds are used or inferred; this evaluates realized flat-stake returns, not expected value or no-loss allocations.
All candidates use the same eligible identities within each cohort; no outcome or grade based race filtering.
Five new candidate policies in this bounded comparison; prior eight-ticket and allocation searches remain additional multiple-testing history.
A favorable retrospective result alone is insufficient to establish prospective profitability.
